license_required.quote: It is a violation of RCW 18.130.190 for any person to practice podiatry in this state unless the person first has obtained a license therefor.

issuing_authority.value: Washington State Department of Health / Secretary of Health
issuing_authority.quote: "Secretary" means the secretary of health or the secretary's designee.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant has not engaged in unprofessional conduct as defined in chapter 18.130 RCW and is not unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety as a result of a physical or mental impairment

degree_required.value: Degree from an approved school of podiatric medicine and surgery
degree_required.quote: The applicant has satisfactorily completed a course in an approved school of podiatric medicine and surgery

accrediting_body.value: Council of Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association
accrediting_body.quote: which may consider official recognition of the Council of Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association in determining the approval of schools of podiatric medicine and surgery

required.quote: The applicant has completed one year of postgraduate podiatric medical training in a program approved by the board

duration.quote: completed one year of postgraduate podiatric medical training in a program approved by the board

kind.quote: one year of postgraduate podiatric medical training in a program approved by the board

exams.name: National Board of Podiatry Examiners examination
exams.quote: applicants must successfully pass the examinations administered by the national board of podiatry examiners

exams.name: Board-administered or board-approved professional qualifications examination
exams.notes: Subject areas determined by board rule; board may approve private testing agency exam.
exams.quote: an examination administered or approved by the board to determine their professional qualifications

available.quote: An applicant holding a license to practice podiatric medicine and surgery in another state may be licensed without examination if the secretary determines that the other state's licensing standards are substantively equivalent to the standards in this state.

requirements.value: Other state's licensing standards must be substantively equivalent to Washington's standards.
requirements.quote: the secretary determines that the other state's licensing standards are substantively equivalent to the standards in this state

regulatory_model.quote: No person may practice or represent himself or herself as a podiatric physician and surgeon without first applying for and receiving a license under this chapter

title_protection.quote: to use the title "podiatrist," "podiatric physician and surgeon," or any other words or letters which designate or tend to designate to the public that the person so treating or holding himself or herself out to treat, is a podiatric physician and surgeon

scope_protection.quote: It is a violation of RCW 18.130.190 for any person to practice podiatry in this state unless the person first has obtained a license therefor.

definition_quote.value: The practice of podiatric medicine and surgery is the diagnosis and the medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, and electrical treatments of ailments of the human foot.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of podiatric medicine and surgery is the diagnosis and the medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, and electrical treatments of ailments of the human foot.

methods_authorized.quote: the medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, and electrical treatments of ailments of the human foot

drug_authority.value: May issue prescriptions valid at any pharmacy for any drug, including narcotics, necessary in the practice of podiatry.
drug_authority.quote: Podiatric physicians and surgeons may issue prescriptions valid at any pharmacy for any drug, including narcotics, necessary in the practice of podiatry.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: The practice of podiatric medicine and surgery is the diagnosis and the medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, and electrical treatments of ailments of the human foot.

amputation_authorized.quote: Podiatrists shall not: (a) Amputate the foot

anesthesia_authority.quote: Administer spinal anesthetic or any anesthetic that renders the patient unconscious

systemic_disease_treatment_excluded.quote: Podiatrists shall not: ... (c) Treat systemic conditions.

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: The performing of podiatric services by persons not licensed under this chapter when performed under the supervision of a licensed podiatrist if those services are authorized by board rule or other law to be so performed

podiatric_assistant_supervision_level.quote: performed under the supervision of a licensed podiatrist if those services are authorized by board rule or other law to be so performed

opioid_prescribing_rules_required.quote: By January 1, 2019, the board must adopt rules establishing requirements for prescribing opioid drugs.
